# The matrix

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/matrix_md.mjs from assets/matrix/*.json. Edit the json, then re-run. -->

Cards describe **structure only**: layout, grammar, motion, finish. Colour, type, radius and borders come from `brand-bind.json`, never from a card.

`roll.mjs` deals one archetype, the BI cards, the motion cards, two finish cards and one signature moment, filtered by `fits`, `needs`, cost budget and rhythm rules.

## Narrative spine (fixed by kind, not rolled)

| Kind | Spine |
|---|---|
| `inspo` | scene → tension → resolution |
| `design-pitch-deck` | problem → vision → proof |
| `implementation-process-map` | inputs → hand-offs → outputs |
| `performance-results` | claim → evidence → caveat |
| `release-notes` | what changed → why it matters → what you do next |
| `dashboard` | state → delta → action |

## Deck A. Layout archetypes

| id | name | fits | cost | reduced | phone |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| broadsheet | Broadsheet | release-notes, design-pitch-deck, inspo | low | unchanged, no motion required | sidenotes fold inline under their paragraph |
| scrolly-spine | Scrollytelling spine | design-pitch-deck, implementation-process-map, inspo | med | all steps stacked, figure shows its final state | figure sits above the steps and is not sticky |
| instrument-panel | Instrument panel | performance-results, dashboard | low | static, no looping elements | KPI strip wraps to two columns, tables scroll inside their wrapper |
| swiss-poster | Swiss poster | inspo, release-notes | low | unchanged | grid collapses to one column, the oversized element keeps its scale |

| ledger | Ledger | performance-results, dashboard | low | unchanged | table scrolls horizontally inside its wrapper with the first column pinned |
| slide-stage | Slide stage | design-pitch-deck | med | every build step shown at once | stage scrolls as a stacked sequence of slides |
| case-file | Case file | performance-results, dashboard | low | unchanged | rail becomes a top list, tabs become stacked sections |

| compare-split | Compare split | release-notes, design-pitch-deck | low | both states shown side by side | states stack vertically, before above after |
| anatomy | Anatomy | release-notes | low | callouts rendered as an ordered list | figure above, callouts as a list below |
| moodfield | Moodfield | inspo | low | static composition | fragments reflow into a single column, order preserved |

| bento-grid | Bento grid | none | low | unchanged | single column |

## Deck C. Motion devices

| id | shows | impl | fits | cost | reduced |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| draw | a connection or a trend exists | Kit.draw: stroke-dashoffset on an svg path | implementation-process-map, design-pitch-deck, dashboard, performance-results | low | path fully drawn |
| grow | magnitudes, ordered | Kit.grow: staggered bar scale from the baseline | performance-results, dashboard, release-notes | low | bars at full length |
| count | a real number arriving | Kit.count: text tween with tabular numerals, final value in markup | performance-results, dashboard, release-notes, inspo | low | final value shown |
| flow-dots | throughput or a hand-off along a real path | Kit.flow: dots travelling along an svg path in the actual hand-off order | implementation-process-map, dashboard | low | static arrowheads |
| scrub | progress through a story | Kit.scrub: scroll linked progress, animation-timeline when available | design-pitch-deck, implementation-process-map, inspo | low | all states shown |
| step-reveal | sequence or dependency order | Kit.reveal: stagger of 0.15 to 0.4 s, visual first, text after | design-pitch-deck, implementation-process-map, release-notes, inspo, dashboard | low | everything visible |
| state-pulse | a live or working state | slow opacity pulse on exactly one element via css animation | dashboard, implementation-process-map | low | static marker |
| morph-text | one statement becoming another | html-motion morph engine, final text in markup | design-pitch-deck, release-notes | med | final text shown |
| field | ambient atmosphere, a decorative layer, at most one per page | html-motion shader engine with a still gradient fallback | inspo, dashboard | high | still frame |
| wipe | before against after | clip-path reveal driven by pointer or keyboard | release-notes, design-pitch-deck | low | both states shown side by side |
| streams | things moving at different rates | html-motion streams engine | inspo, dashboard | med | final frame |

## Banned motion

- marquees
- parallax for its own sake
- spin
- flash
- count-ups on non-numeric data
- autoplay loops longer than 8 s without a pause control
